title: SRD 5.1 importer: section detection + orchestrator
description:
Add the cross-cutting section-detection layer that finds 'Spells', 'Monsters', 'Classes', etc. section boundaries inside the SRD PDF so each kind parser receives the correct slice of PageText[]. Today the spell parser (`parseSpells.ts`) runs over the entire PDF and tolerates false negatives; once more parsers land, mis-attribution becomes possible (e.g. class-spell-list 'Magic Missile' showing up as a spell-section name line, or 'Hit Points' headers in a class entry being mis-detected by future parsers). This issue adds a section-anchor table and an orchestrator that dispatches the correct page range to each kind parser.

Reference implementation: extend `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/index.ts` and add a new `sections.ts` module under the same directory. Update `parseSpells.ts` to accept a narrowed slice (no behavior change for tests that already pass narrowed slices).

This is the architectural prerequisite for every other 0m9.5 child parser. Land first.
acceptance_criteria:
- New module `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sections.ts` defines a section-anchor table identifying each SRD top-level chapter by header line.
- Orchestrator in `index.ts` dispatches per-kind page slices to parsers; `parseSpells` is refactored to accept a narrowed slice without behavior change.
- Existing pipeline test still passes byte-stable; importer output for spells is unchanged for the same PDF.
- A regression test verifies a known false-positive shape (e.g. a class-list spell name appearing in a non-spell section) is not mis-extracted by the spell parser when run through the orchestrator.
- README updated to describe the section-anchor table and how to add a new kind to the orchestrator.
close_reason: Code (sections.ts, orchestrator wiring, regression tests) shipped in #92 as part of the SRD foundation. Remaining README gap (section-anchor table + how-to-add-a-new-kind) closed in PR #93.
